title: Short Circuit
build: TAP of the original Ocean cassette (643,155 bytes): a 701-byte boot program in the KERNAL's format, then Ocean's turbo loader reading 275 pages of 256 bytes: the loading tune, the loading picture and the whole of memory from $0400 to $FFFF, which holds both parts of the game

tools.host: Bronze run: macOS arm64 (Apple silicon). Silver run: Linux x86_64 (WSL2) on Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200, Ubuntu, Intel x86_64
tools.emulator: Bronze run: release v3.14.0, v3.14.0-macos-arm64-gui.dmg. Silver run: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.2, commit 1e83aab134, driven through kit/c64/vice.py
tools.publication: Python 3 and node 24; tap.py, media.py, symbols_export.py, listing.py, frame.py and build.py
tools.subagents: Bronze run: none. Silver run: seven audit checkers and one sample checker, one at a time, all on claude-opus-5-5

accuracy.note: checked by the model that wrote the comments, not by another: 2 comments carried a wrong number (rows, an entry's place in a table), 10 variable comments named the wrong routine as writer or reader because their owner labels were missing; all 12 corrected and every other comment of the same two kinds regenerated

28 comments of code routines drawn at random and read against their code by the model that wrote them, not by another: 5 were wrong in a detail (a label taken for a mid-instruction operand of a BIT skip, a missing step in a menu, a loose description of two routines, voice 3's command table one word off); all 5 fixed, and the false symbols of the same kind ($03A9, $05A9, $07A9) corrected

six address ranges, each by a fresh checker: 454 comments wrong (424 in a detail, 30 in their main claim), all corrected, with 4 that repeated a corrected belief; and every claim in facts.md, 126, of which 12 were corrected

checked by a checker that took no part in writing or auditing; 5 of the 10 were writer lists that left out the zeroing at start-up and reset, corrected in all 73 such lists; 105 comments corrected in all, the 10 with them

exclude: the screen memory and sprite pointers of video bank 3: the start-up at $9762 clears and redraws the screens before they are shown, so the loaded bytes are never displayed
include: RAM under the I/O area: character sets that the video chip reads in bank 3 ($D000 and $D800), which the processor reads only with I/O banked out

regions: zero page: pointers, scroll and stick state, the sound voices' script pointers
game variables: sprite slots, message queue, inventory, score
part one's map: three rows of 256 tiles
part two's map: two rows of 256 tiles
part two's and part one's tiles
the title picture: screen colours and bitmap
the music driver's work area and note tables
the tune table and the voices' scripts
